Package de.hof.dms.controller

Class FolderController

java.lang.Object
de.hof.dms.controller.FolderController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/folders") @Profile("!no-mongo") public class FolderController extends Object
REST endpoints for browsing and managing the folder hierarchy under /api/folders.

Requires an authenticated user; per-folder visibility and mutation are enforced by FolderService against the resolved CurrentUser. Only active when a MongoDB backend is present (profile !no-mongo).

    • list

      @GetMapping public FolderPage list(@RequestParam(value="parentId",required=false) String parentId, @RequestParam(value="page",defaultValue="0") int page, @RequestParam(value="size",defaultValue="20") int size, @AuthenticationPrincipal org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt jwt)
      Lists the child folders of a given parent (or top-level folders when none is given), filtered to those visible to the current user.
      Parameters:
      parentId - optional parent folder id; null lists top-level folders
      page - zero-based page index
      size - page size
      jwt - the current user's JWT
      Returns:
      a page of folders visible to the user

    • update

      @PatchMapping("/{id}") public FolderResponse update(@PathVariable String id, @RequestBody UpdateFolderRequest request, @AuthenticationPrincipal org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt jwt)

    • delete

      @DeleteMapping("/{id}") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Void> delete(@PathVariable String id, @RequestParam(value="recursive",defaultValue="false") boolean recursive, @AuthenticationPrincipal org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt jwt)
      Deletes the given folder, returning HTTP 204. When recursive is false a non-empty folder is rejected by the service; when true its contents are removed too.
      Parameters:
      id - the folder id
      recursive - whether to delete the folder together with its contents
      jwt - the current user's JWT
      Returns:
      a 204 no-content response
